title.narrative: Food Security And Resilience In Lascahobas, Haiti

description.narrative: AAH and its partner COSADH propose to use the funds to support the local civil society and authority's effort in Lascahobas to contribute to food security and resilience, by supporting 23 groups (women groups or mixed groups) of producers / transformers. In a transversal way, the project will:1) contribute to climate justice by promoting agroecology and bringing community-led agricultural actions that are environmentally friendly, 2) mitigate gender-based violence against women and girls, and reinforce women's economic powerThe project aligns with AAH Country Strategic Plan (CSP) where environmental protection, food security and empowerment of women, girls and young people are strategic priorities. It is also a continuation of the activities already undertaken by ActionAid and COSADH in the community. Finally, this project will allow AAH to strengthen and consolidate the TIF project that aims to empower politically and economically youth in Lascahobas and to serve as a niche in support of the Individual Giving Program (also funded by People’s Postcode Lottery) that AAH is putting in place. The project proposes the 2 following pillars to address the main challenges faces by Lascahobas, namely poverty and food insecurity, to encourage youth people to get involved in agriculture instead of leaving the area and to strengthen women socio-economic position to reduce GBV, while improving the resilience of the community.- Increase food production of cereals and fruits, through agroecological technics and reforestation of land with fruit trees, to improve income. - Enhance food production through the agroprocessing and selling of food related products, to improve income and empower women.The project aims at supporting and strengthening 11 groups of mix farmers and 12 groups of women. In a cross-cutting way, the project will contribute to the mitigation of GBV though economic empowerment and sensitization activities. It will also support the mitigation of climate change impact by the promotion and application of agroecological practices, technical support to farmers including training

activity-date.narrative: April 2025-March 2026 will be funded by People's Postcode Lottery International Trust 25/26
